tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (12.2:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: burgundy-primary
tokens.usage: Deep burgundy evokes aged wine, leather- ║. Used as background on `body`; shadow/glow on `.filter-input:focus`, `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`. 8.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: burgundy-dark
tokens.usage: Nearly black burgundy for maximum depth and ║. Used as text on `.menu-toggle`, `.page-title`, `.stat-value`. 12.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: burgundy-light
tokens.usage: Declared in the style's palette. 6.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal-primary
tokens.usage: Warm charcoal suggests aged stone, ║. Used as text on `body`, `.btn-tertiary:hover, .btn-tertiary:focus`, `.filter-input`. 12.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: gold-accent
tokens.usage: Antique gold for illuminated manuscripts, ║. Used as text on `.logo`, `.card-image`, `.footer-column h3`. 2.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Softened gold for hover states, maintaining ║. Used as text on `.nav-main a:hover, .nav-main a:focus`, `.footer-links a:hover, .footer-links a:focus`. 1.6:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Aged parchment evokes medieval manuscripts, ║. Used as text on `.nav-main a`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary:hover, .btn-secondary:focus`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: parchment-dark
tokens.usage: Darkened parchment for layered backgrounds,║. Used as text on `.footer-links a`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stone-gray
tokens.usage: Cathedral stone for secondary text, Gothic ║. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.meta-item`. 3.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: stone-light
tokens.usage: Lighter stone for tertiary elements, subtle ║.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.form-success`. 4.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Antique gold for illuminated manuscripts, ║. Used as background on `.nav-main a:hover, .nav-main a:focus`.
